_experiment.description: [seed 4] Block D. Structured pruning of [784,512,512,10] on full-resolution MNIST (48 crossbars dense at S=128) with Omega = 2 000 training images (B = 10 000 costs ~250 s/step on this net; B = 2 000 validated against B = 10 000 by e44); 900 neuron steps (raised from 800 on 2026-10-07: seed 0 reached only [136,95] = 17 crossbars at step 800 because the layers are pruned unevenly) to reach both hidden widths <= 128 = 9 crossbars. Shared dense net for the d_W neuron search and magnitude neuron pruning (paired).
